title: UPPSC Assistant Grade LT Grade Teacher Recruitment 2025 Mains Result 2026
vacancyDetails: UPPSC LT Grade Assistant Teacher mains result for various subjects including Science, Sanskrit, Home Science, Commerce, English, Biology, Urdu, Music, Arts, Agriculture, Horticulture, Sociology, Physical Education, Hindi and Computer Science.
qualification: Bachelor Degree in relevant subject with B.Ed. as per UPPSC LT Grade Assistant Teacher recruitment notification.
ageLimit: Minimum age 21 years and maximum age 40 years as on 01/07/2025; age relaxation as per UPPSC rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: ₹125; SC / ST: ₹65; PH: ₹25.
selectionProcess: Phase I exam → Phase II / mains exam → Result / merit list → final selection as per UPPSC process
documentsRequired: Roll number, registration details, result login or download link and supporting educational or category documents for verification stages.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official UPPSC portal
2. Open the result or mains result section
3. Select the relevant subject or result link
4. Download the PDF and check the roll numbers and merit status
5. Save the result copy for future stages
shortDescription: UPPSC LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Result 2026 has been released for multiple subjects. Candidates can download the subject-wise result PDFs from the official UPPSC portal.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the Assistant Teacher LT Grade Recruitment 2025 Mains Result 2026 for various subjects.

Candidates who appeared in the LT Grade mains examination can download subject-wise result PDFs from the official UPPSC result portal and check their roll number status.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 28/07/2025
  • Last date to apply: 28/08/2025
  • Fee payment last date: 28/08/2025
  • Correction last date: 04/09/2025
  • Phase I exam: 06-07 & 21 December 2025
  • Phase II / mains exam: 17-25 January 2026
  • Computer subject exam date: 05/04/2026
  • Mains result available: 18/09/2026

Result links are available for Science, Commerce, Agriculture / Horticulture, Music, Arts, Urdu, English, Biology, Sanskrit, Home Science, Hindi, Maths, Social Science, Physical Education and Computer subject.
